title: E2.4 node egress pulse (FlowView.pulse_egress / NodeSite.pulse_egress) has zero behavioral assertions — smoke-executed only
detail: E2.4 requires serialization VISIBLE in 3D at nodes. The pulse path runs via main._process during scene tests but no test asserts a pulse fires on admission, the cooldown, or the tween — a broken pulse stays green.
recommended_fix: Add a headless pin: after a directed admission (node_admissions>0), call flow_view.pulse_egress() and assert the NodeSite Visual scale bumped then decayed; assert cooldown suppresses a second immediate pulse.

title: HUD SLA breach chip (Hud.set_breaches + main._breach_lines) — no test asserts breach display or the both-latches fix
evidence:
hud.gd:56-62: "func set_breaches(lines: String) -> void:
	if lines.is_empty():
		_breach_panel.visible = false
		return
	if _breach.text != lines:
		_breach.text = lines
	_breach_panel.visible = true"; main.gd:190 "func _breach_lines() -> String:" with comment "Independent ifs: a latency latch must never hide a co-occurring loss breach". grep -rn "set_breaches|Hud" tests/ → no matches.
detail: The both-latches fold was a fixed bug, yet no test pins _breach_lines output for latency-only, loss-only, and both-latch states, nor chip hide-on-empty. README promises 'the HUD chip names it'.
recommended_fix: Unit-pin main._breach_lines against a hand-built sla dict (lat only / loss only / both / clean) and Hud.set_breaches visibility transitions; assert the chip hides when lines is empty.

title: Lane-dependent traversal speed (Express 200 / Standard 100 / BE 60 milli/tick) never differentially tested — E2.4 'class-dependent speed' is unpinned
evidence: sim_core.gd:384: "pkt.progress_milli = int(pkt.progress_milli) + SimBalance.LANE_SPEED_MILLI[int(pkt.lane)]"; sim_balance.gd:54: "const LANE_SPEED_MILLI := [200, 100, 60] # travel milli-units per tick, by lane (speed = priority)". grep -rn "LANE_SPEED" tests/ → no matches; test_sim_qos pins admission order and throughput shares, never arrival-time ordering by lane.
detail: Every QoS test runs on default lanes or measures delivered counts; no test assigns classes to different lanes and asserts the Express packet arrives sooner. A reordered LANE_SPEED_MILLI would pass the whole suite.
recommended_fix: Add a pin: identical long pipe, one email on Express vs one on Best-effort (via cls_lane), assert arrival tick ordering and approximate transit ratios 200:60.

title: Editor 'Regenerate Preview' button path (_regenerate_preview) never executed by any test — tests replicate its body
evidence:
main.gd:151-156: "func _regenerate_preview() -> void:
	if not Engine.is_editor_hint():
		return
	_clear_generated()
	_generate_world(WorldSeed.wedge_layout(SEED))". test_editor_preview.gd:39-46 calls "scene._clear_generated()" / "scene._generate_world(WorldSeed.wedge_layout(SEED))" directly; grep -rn "_regenerate_preview" tests/ → no matches (only the annotation string-check at test_editor_preview.gd:23).
detail: The folded-QoL acceptance ('button runs the SAME seeded generation') is verified only by string-matching the annotation and by calling the two helpers by hand. If the callback drifts (different seed/layout), all tests stay green.
recommended_fix: Invoke the real callback through a seam: make the editor-hint guard injectable (or test-call it after faking the hint) and assert _regenerate_preview() alone reproduces the boot staging.

title: Streaming-class latency SLA breach (tighter 1200 ms threshold) never tested — only email latency breaches
evidence:
test_sim_sla.gd:22-31: "func _latency_breach_long_pipe() -> void:
	var sim := make_sim()
	var ext := house_pair_extremes(sim)
	var a: int = ext.longest[0]
	var b: int = ext.longest[1]
	...
		sim._spawn_packet(a, b, "email")" — the latency-breach and threshold-bites legs stage email only; streaming appears solely at line 74 (loss latch) and line 102 (gentle-clean).
detail: E2.5 says latency/loss per class. Email latency breach + both-class loss breach are pinned, but the streaming 1200 ms latch (72 ticks, a different constant and tighter bound) is never fired — a class-specific threshold regression passes.
recommended_fix: Clone the long-pipe breach leg for streaming: spawn streaming on the longest arc, assert lat_breach/lat_tick latch and that it fires at the tighter 72-tick tolerance, not email's 120.

title: set_lanes per-value bounds branch (share <0 or >100 with total ≤100) untested
detail: A negative or >100 individual share that still sums ≤100 takes the untested branch. Deleting the per-value guard passes the entire suite; the panel never sends such payloads, but the bus contract allows any caller.
recommended_fix: Add two no-op cases to _command_validation_noops: alloc [120,-20,0] and [-10,60,50], asserting the bundle's alloc is unchanged and the commands are still recorded.

title: FlowView rendering edge branches unasserted: alloc-change rebuild (strands re-thicken), MAX_DOTS_PER_PIPE ghost-guard, reversed b→a dot rendering
evidence: flow_view.gd:51: "elif meta.get(\"alloc\", []) != p.alloc:" → _rebuild_view (no test asserts strand thickness changes after a set_lanes apply); flow_view.gd:133-134: "if used >= MAX_DOTS_PER_PIPE:\n\t\tcapped = true # density speaks; hide the rest — never ghost"; flow_view.gd:143: "t = 1.0 - t # b -> a traversal renders reversed". grep tests/ shows no reference to MAX_DOTS_PER_PIPE or the reversal.
detail: Spec acceptance says 'strands re-thicken' on QoS apply; the dot cap and the b→a interpolation inversion are exercised implicitly at best and never asserted — a regressed inversion or ghost-dot regression stays green.
recommended_fix: Pin tube radii per lane share after a set_lanes apply; flood >48 in-flight packets and assert hidden surplus dots; spawn a→b and b→a packet and assert dot t-positions move apart correctly.

title: tools/determinism_log.gd untested and its command timing (tick 300) diverges from the replay test (tick 120) — the 'never drift apart' claim is overstated
evidence: determinism_log.gd:30: "if t == ticks / 3:" (=300) vs test_sim_replay.gd:22: "if t == 120:" — same REPLAY_CMDS, different worlds; committed captures/05 shows "traffic carried: 10 packets delivered across the run" while test_sim_replay pins "carried >= 12". The tool's FAIL path (quit(1)) has no test.
detail: Shared constants pin the command LIST, not application timing, so the committed capture can silently stop evidencing the tested scenario; a broken tool (never run in CI) would still exit the gate.
recommended_fix: Move the apply-tick into test_sim_base (e.g. REPLAY_CMD_TICK), use it in both, and assert the tool's own log line matches the test's delivered count; optionally run the tool in the suite.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
evidence: test_sim_qos.gd: "check(stream >= 95 and stream <= 160, \"reservation: Express holds ~50%%...\")"; test_sim_replay.gd: "check(a.dump_state() == b.dump_state(), \"replay: final state dumps byte-identical\")"; test_view_purity.gd: "check(caught, \"purity negative control: a real sim mutation IS detected (this pin can fail)\")"; test_sim_sla.gd: "check(bool(sim.sla[\"email\"].loss_breach), \"SLA: email loss breach detected (>30%)\")"; run_tests.gd: "failures += 1" for aborted coroutines.
detail: P0 (5 epic contracts) 100% — each has a direct pin plus mutation/negative-control legs. P1 ≈96% (23.5/24: set_lanes sub-branch, editor button binding partial). Overall ≈84% (≈30/35 behaviors). Visible-layer P2 ≈40% asserted, filed as warnings above.
recommended_fix: Raise P2 to ≥80%: assert egress pulse, HUD breach lines, lane-speed ordering, strand re-thicken, dot cap/reversal; invoke the real _regenerate_preview; add the streaming latency-breach leg; share REPLAY_CMD_TICK with the determinism tool.
